### Revvity to Present at Upcoming Investor Conferences


10/13/2026


[Download this Press Release (opens in new window) PDF 101 KB](https://s202.q4cdn.com/908952201/files/doc_news/Revvity-to-Present-at-Upcoming-Investor-Conferences-a2ca4a7f8-2026.pdf)


WALTHAM, Mass.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Revvity, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.revvity.com%2F&esheet=54620476&newsitemid=20261013448512&lan=en-US&anchor=Revvity%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=07816996ccb465110c62702d85bafc82) (NYSE: RVTY), today announced it will present at the following investor conferences:


2026 Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference
Tuesday, November 17, 2026
8:00 a.m. GMT – Prahlad Singh, president and chief executive officer


9th Annual Evercore Healthcare Conference
Wednesday, December 2, 2026
9:10 a.m. ET – Prahlad Singh


Attendees will receive an update on the Company and its strategic priorities during fireside chats.


Live audio webcasts will be available on the[Events](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.revvity.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54620476&newsitemid=20261013448512&lan=en-US&anchor=Events&index=2&md5=20985b59305a2db7d250e17ab606bc28) section of the Company’s website. Replays of the presentations will be posted on the[Revvity Investor Relations website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.revvity.com%2Fhome%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54620476&newsitemid=20261013448512&lan=en-US&anchor=Revvity+Investor+Relations+website&index=3&md5=3a213dd56baf2a9aa53699d8fc98ceed) after the events and will be available for at least 30 days.


**About Revvity**


At Revvity, “impossible” is inspiration, and “can’t be done” is a call to action. Revvity provides health science solutions, technologies, expertise, and services that deliver complete workflows from discovery to development, and diagnosis to cure. Revvity is revolutionizing what’s possible in healthcare, with specialized focus areas in translational multi-omics technologies, biomarker identification, imaging, prediction, screening, detection and diagnosis, informatics and more.


With 2025 revenue of $2.9 billion and approximately 11,000 employees, Revvity serves customers across pharmaceutical and biotech, diagnostic labs, academia and governments. It is part of the S&P 500 index and has customers in more than 160 countries.
